policy.name: Advanced Imaging Policy AI-9: Lumbar spine MRI (synthetic)
policy.text: MRI of the lumbar spine without and with contrast is medically necessary for low back pain when ANY ONE of the following is present: (1) suspected cauda equina syndrome (saddle anesthesia, new urinary retention, or new bowel or bladder incontinence); (2) a history of cancer with new or worsening back pain; (3) suspected spinal infection (fever with back pain, IV drug use, or a recent spinal procedure); (4) a progressive or severe motor deficit; (5) persistent radicular pain after at least 6 weeks of documented conservative therapy, when surgery or epidural injection is being considered.
